In another instance, after Fiona was hospitalized, she disguised herself as a nurse and paid a visit to her subordinate, mostly because she wanted to wear the nurse's uniform, with Fiona accusing her of playing around. She also teases Fiona about not pushing herself too much, even for Twilight, implying her awareness of Fiona's feelings for her co-worker.

Keen Intellect: As a spy handler, Sylvia has memorized and remembered the many agents and missions that she is in charge of. She is also able to spot minute details, such as when she spotted Pance Karmer out of place in a crowd while disguised as a security officer, noting minor details like him missing a baton or appearing on the wrong patrol route.

Disguise: Sylvia competently alters her appearance, as she often assumes various façades to shake off SSS pursuers in order to contact agents like Twilight outside the embassy and has disguised herself as a nurse to fill in for Twilight and Nightfall's jobs at Berlint General Hospital. However, she does appear to make occasional mistakes, as she once forgot to remove the price tag from the coat of her disguise.

Spy Handler: As a handler, Sylvia is the Westalian Intelligence agency's primary liaison with agents in Ostania and is responsible for managing them and their missions. Her primary duties include watching for signs of restlessness in Ostania and deploying her agents to prevent any potential incidents. Despite the strict surveillance from the nation's secret police, Sylvia manages to evade notice while competently handling her agents, earning her the nickname "Fullmetal Lady."

Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Sylvia is skilled in unarmed combat and readily makes use of makeshift weapons as shown with her quick immobilization of Pance Karmer with a belt in thwarting his assassination attempt against Jonas Wellman.

Weapons: During the terrorist bombing incident, Sylvia is seen loading a gun. However, her skills and capabilities with it remain to be unseen.

Age: Although her precise age is unknown, she is visibly disadvantaged by it with bouts of weakness and back and shoulder pain after combat, which secretly concerns her.

(To Student Terrorists): "Have any of you ever killed anyone before? Have you ever been killed before? Have you ever had a limb torn off by an artillery shell? Have you ever heard the sound of bones shattering? Have you ever smelled the reek of rotting flesh? Have you ever found the crushed bodies of your parents and siblings in a pile of rubble that used to be your home? Have you ever discovered a blown-off piece of your lover stuck to a wall? Have you ever been so hungry you tried to eat tree bark? Have you ever stewed human flesh in a pot? Have you ever convinced yourself your enemy was subhuman so you could slaughter them like animals? Have you ever been so haunted by shame and regret afterward that you cried until you puked? Have you ever had friends who did the same, and took their own lives? Did you learn nothing about war at your university?"
(To Loid Forger): "Peace won the day. That's all that really matters."
(To Loid, before his cruise trip): "We'll consider it a part of Anya's care and education for Operation Strix. Agent Twilight, I expect you to execute your mission of rest and recreation as thoroughly as you would any other."
(About Loid): "Heh. Sometimes I can't tell if that man is highly capable or highly incompetent."
(To Loid, while training him): "Don't view everything in terms of black or white. Don't try to make everything fit into your preconceived notions. And don't rationalize! Are those brains of yours purely for show? Well?"
(To Aaron, about herself): "I used to keep a much neater house, but... when you've been alone for long enough... stuff like that just doesn't seem to matter anymore."

entries.name: Fiona Frost
entries.content:
“You're weak. You're afraid to die. You're afraid of being betrayed. You're incapable of trusting anyone. You have no one to believe in. No one to gaze at and intently scrutinize. You've given up on the world. Now you're just an empty man meddling in it for no reason greater than your own amusement. But I'm not afraid. I believe in that man. I think of him and think of him and think of him and think of him and think of him and think of him. It's what makes me strong!! It's why you have no hope of beating me!”
— Fiona to Winston Wheeler

Fiona Frost (フィオナ・フロスト, Fiona Furosuto?) is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a spy for WISE who acts under the codename "Nightfall" (〈夜帷とばり〉, <Tobari>?). She works undercover as an office worker at Berlint General Hospital to support Loid Forger's cover story.

Fiona is a fairly tall and very attractive woman with a pale complexion and a slender figure. She has bobbed hair of a light lavender color and a long fringe covering much of the right side of her face, swept behind her left ear. Fiona has cold purple eyes framed by light-colored eyelashes and is most often seen wearing an emotionless expression. She is described as beautiful by Yor and has several admirers. Fiona's age is currently uncertain, but she appears to be younger than Loid.

Fiona is introduced wearing a dark blue pea coat with yellow (black in the manga) buttons, a purple sweater with turtleneck and black leather pants underneath, brown leather gloves, and ankle-high button boots with black heels when visiting the Forgers' apartment. Her stud earrings are black and take the shape of WISE's symbol.

When working in Berlint General Hospital as a psychiatric nurse, Fiona typically wears a long-sleeved dark blue sweater, a gray vest with black stripes and buttons over a white long-sleeved shirt, a black knee-length office skirt, dark gray tights, and black shoes with heels.

After being trained by Twilight to hide her true emotions, Fiona tends to remain emotionless on the surface—even when making a mental confession of love to him. Fiona is deeply in love with Loid, to the point of being capable of compromising Operation Strix by visiting the Forgers' residence and even telling Sylvia Sherwood and Loid himself to replace Yor and let her take over the role of the Forger wife. Fiona thinks of herself as Loid's superior partner and wishes to separate him from Yor so they can be together. However, her desire and love for Loid make Fiona unable to comprehend the bigger picture, as fulfilling them would cause suspicions and compromise Operation Strix.

To others, like her co-workers, Fiona is seen as an unscrupulous and ambitious woman, capable of backstabbing her peers to build a reputation even bigger than Twilight's own. While this is true to an extent, her desire to build her reputation stems not from ambition or a lack of scruples per se but rather from her desire to impress Loid.

Despite her usually reserved facade, Fiona has let her true feelings surface in rare instances. After Loid gets mocked by the Bolic Brothers during the Campbelldon tennis tournament, Fiona retaliates by beating them with tennis smashes. Later, when she challenges Yor to a tennis match with the intention of breaking her, Fiona is visibly in shock upon witnessing Yor's absurd strength and is crushed after losing to her. As she speeds away in her car, she breaks into tears and declares that she will never give up her ambition. Later, when she sees Loid defeated and his life endangered at the hands of Winston Wheeler, Fiona goes into a rage and openly speaks her feelings as she defeats the rogue spy. She is also capable of severe embarrassment, which happens to her after recognizing that Sylvia knows about her feelings for Twilight.

Fiona can act hastily in getting missions done, especially if Loid is involved. For example, when infiltrating the Campbelldon tennis tournament with Loid, Fiona pushed herself to complete their mission and impress him as much as she could, to the point of bruising her hands. Fiona is also very distrustful of others and is willing to use them as pawns to fulfill her goals, like when she gained the help of a counterfeiter by calling SSS agents on him and subsequently protecting him from them. Despite her methods, Fiona is a proficient spy and capable of partnering with others, like Franky, who she has grown to trust to some extent.

Enhanced Strength and Stamina: While not as powerful compared to the stronger characters in the series, Fiona has impressive physical strength, shown when she took down the Bolic Brothers with her tennis smashes, who were strong enough to rip apart a steel fence with their bare hands, and, to some degree, even managed to rally a shot by Yor in a tennis match. After losing to Yor in said match, Fiona took to the mountains to train for her revenge match, which has improved her strength and endurance. She was able to pull a pile of tied-up logs with a bear sitting upon it and tame a mountain goat and an alligator.

When Fiona reaches a state of complete rage, her physical prowess becomes extraordinary, allowing her to deliver inhumanly powerful blows. During her confrontation with Winston, her intense anger enabled her to incapacitate him effortlessly, disabling both his arms and sending him flying. It is implied that Fiona's training in the mountains played a significant role in enhancing her strength to such extraordinary levels. This training also likely contributed to her exceptional combat abilities, granting her tremendous power when her emotions are unleashed. However, in this state, the strength and force of Fiona's blows are so great that they have serious effects on her body. Every limb she used to strike Winston with broke, and even a missed punch dislocated her arm.

Enhanced Speed and Agility: Fiona has demonstrated to be quite nimble and fast. She is capable of performing several acrobatic moves to avoid rubber bullets fired from multiple angles in the middle of an underground tennis match. She was also able to dodge a bullet from an SSS agent while simultaneously throwing a knife at his hand to disable him. When enraged, Fiona's speed gains a massive increase, as during her fight with Winston, her movements were so fast that the skilled spy was barely able to dodge her attacks.

Enhanced Durability and Endurance: Fiona is shown to be quite resistant to injuries. As mentioned above, in her enraged state, every limb she used to strike Winston with broke, and even a missed punch dislocated her arm, Despite those injuries, Fiona continued the fight without any problem and was completely unfazed by any possible pain that came out of it until her adrenaline wore off.

Poker Face: After training herself to show no emotions, Fiona is able to completely conceal them, making it impossible for anyone to tell what emotion she is feeling. At all times, she has a stone-cold look on her face, whether she is happy, upset, angry, or even while internally proposing her love. Anya is one of the few people who knows her true nature thanks to her psychic powers, with the other being Sylvia, who has been shown to see through Fiona's facade.

Enhanced Senses: Fiona has good eyesight and can spot things from far away, whether it be watching someone from across a hall, noticing SSS agents stalking from behind, or detecting the little movements of a person through binoculars.

Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant: After being trained by Twilight, Fiona has proven to be a formidable combatant. During an urgent mission intended for her former mentor, she took on an entire enemy group by herself and is capable of slamming a man into the ground after lifting him over her head.

Weapons: Fiona is very adept with weaponry. She has her own personal handgun. Also, in a mission where Fiona took Loid's place in exterminating an enemy group, she is seen equipped with a vast variety of weapons, which include, but are not limited to, an assault rifle and grenades.

Twilight: Although this is not a skill as such, Fiona's unwavering dedication to keep fighting, her pursuit of strength, and her overall demeanor are profoundly influenced by her connection to Twilight. He serves as her primary motivation and driving force for almost everything she does. The deep attachment she feels towards him leads her to go to extraordinary lengths, even engaging in confrontations or causing harm to others if they obstruct Twilight and his ideals.

Fiona's abilities are significantly amplified when she believes she can satisfy Twilight, as demonstrated during the Campbelldon tournament, where both of them collaborated seamlessly, utilizing Loid's motivation as a driving force to achieve victory in a surprising manner, working in perfect coordination to defeat their rivals. Her devotion to him extends to an extreme level, as she would willingly make the ultimate sacrifice for his well-being. A clear example of this is seen when Winston incapacitates Twilight, and Fiona, fueled by her fierce protectiveness, delivers inhuman blows to Winston, disregarding her own safety, resulting in breaking most of her bones. Loid's presence and happiness form the foundation of Fiona's actions, pushing her to extraordinary measures to ensure his safety and fulfill his desires.

(To herself, about Loid's smile with the Forgers): "Lionel, from the National Defense Force. Lawrence, a black market dealer, Robert, the politician's secretary. I've spent so much time studying so many Twilights. I know that masterful fake smile of his. And I can see a tiny hint of real emotion... seeping out from beneath it."
(To herself): "I am thankful for the rain... for hiding my emotions. Because we're spies, living in a world of shadows... because my beloved trainer taught me to... until the day that this cold war ends. But for now... even just being your cover story wife would be enough. I just want to be by your side. On our joint mission, I'll show you how capable I truly am. I'll make you realize that I'm the only one fit to be your wife!"
(To herself): "Twilight. My mentor. You've changed. You've developed inappropriate emotions from your time in the Forger Family. You're a knife with a chipped blade. And when I see what you've become, it makes my heart ache. Oh, Twilight..."
(To herself, after seeing Twilight's serious mode): "There it is. That's the Twilight who won my heart. The Twilight I can't stop chasing. The Twilight I want at my side. The Twilight who turned my respect into love. The Twilight whose dreams became my dreams. What I'm saying is… I love you."
(To herself): "What a wonderful man you are, Twilight. I'll achieve peace between East and West. And I’ll do it all for you."
(To herself): "The moment he referred to her as just "Yor" was the moment I knew I was only gonna get his official explanation. Nevertheless, his analysis was correct. By framing it was necessary for the mission, he's made it impossible for me to object. That was a dirty move, Twilight."

entries.name: WISE Agent
entries.content:
“Just goes to show, you think you know someone, but you never really do.”
— The Agent to a WISE Rookie about Jonas Wellman

The unnamed WISE Agent is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He works as a senior spy for WISE in Ostania.

The WISE Agent is an older man with a slicked back brown gray hair styled in a pompadour and Chevron-style mustache.

He wears a black jacket over a collared white shirt, with a striped tie and grey pants. Occasionally, in order to blend in with ordinary civilians, the Agent wears a white cap with the WISE logo on it. For the same purpose, he also has a false beard and another light cap with a dark letter "W" above the visor.

The Agent is a reliable ally to the agents of WISE. He is a light-hearted man, often making jokes and witty remarks around Sylvia and his fellow agents. However, he does show a more serious side, especially while on missions. When not on the field, the Agent can be seen lounging around on the couch of the safe house, but he carefully gathers intel from word-of-mouth to television news to share with Sylvia. Despite his experience, he sometimes acts impulsively, as during the terrorist plot to assassinate Minister Brantz, he was in a hurry to capture Keith Kepler, the group's leader, and almost opened a door which was rigged to detonate had Loid not stopped him.

Disguise: The Agent can decently disguise himself while on missions or contacting other agents in public.

Expert Marksman: The Agent is able to conduct firefights even in moving vehicles.

Strength: The Agent appears to have decent strength, as he was able to carry Winston Wheeler, who was noted by Loid to be quite heavy, on his shoulder while escaping Shellbury, though he did show some strain while carrying him.

A fellow co-worker of Twilight, the Agent works alongside the master spy, assisting him in missions across Ostania. He often teases Loid about his double life, remarking that it must be hard for him to balance parenthood and his mission, joking that he showed up for nothing after the Red Circus bus hijacking crisis was resolved without the need for the SSS strike team that they infiltrated, and suggesting that Loid should comfort Anya as they watched her and Yor reunite.

Later, after their squad captured the rogue agent and mole Winston Wheeler, the exhausted Agent invites Loid to go out for some drinks. When he is turned down, he remarks that Loid is only a family man whenever he wants to get out of something.

Unlike the rest of Sylvia's subordinates, the Agent does not fear her, as he tends to make jokes around and to her, despite her strict demeanor. When it comes to following the Handler's orders, the Agent diligently follows and makes sure they are seen through. Sometimes he even argues with her, as shown when he tried to defend Erik Zacharis's hobby and chastised her for her slovenliness around their office.

Both the Agent and Nightfall are field operatives who have been entrusted with several missions. While he does trust Fiona and her capabilities, the Agent, like the rest of his peers, sees Fiona as a cold-hearted woman trying to make a name for herself, to the point that he warns Loid to keep an eye on her when they are assigned to a joint operation together.

During the operation to apprehend Winston Wheeler, both Fiona and the Agent were assigned to it alongside Loid. While Loid aimed to divert the attention of the SSS, the two maintained close proximity to Winston, seizing any opportunity to catch him. After successfully capturing Winston, the Agent commented on Fiona's stubbornness and said it would eventually get her killed when she insisted on walking while injured.

(To Loid Forger and Fiona Frost): "Heaven forbid. How are we supposed to stay level-headed when we're stepping through the gates of hell here?"

entries.name: Wilker
entries.content:
“Who, Yuri? The kid's adorable, am I right? Like a cute little puppy!”
— Wilker about Yuri Briar

Director Wilker (ウィルカー局長, Wirukā Kyokucho?) is the director of the State Security Service. He is the man who scouted Yuri Briar into the organization and dotes on him because he finds him adorable.

Wilker appears to be a middle-aged man with receding dirty blond hair and long sideburns to form a mutton chops beard.

Wilker is always seen at SSS headquarters and wears his standard SSS uniform. His distinguishing feature is his dark sunglasses that cover his intimidating eyes.

On the surface, Wilker appears to be a cheerful man and is always seen with a smile. His demeanor allows him to get along with many of his subordinates, whom he sometimes invites out for drinking parties after work. Hiding underneath his jovial demeanor is a man who takes his work very seriously and dislikes those in allegiance with WISE.

One year before the start of Operation Strix, Wilker recruited Yuri, who was initially working at the Ministry for Foreign Affairs, to the SSS. When asked by his other subordinates why he took on such a young man into their organization, Wilker claimed it was because he found Yuri to be "adorable" and like a "cute little puppy."

After one of the Lieutenant's subordinate asks why Wilker recruited Yuri, the Lieutenant recounts what the director told him in the past.

After Yuri arrests journalist Franklin Perkin, Wilker congratulates the young man at headquarters and says he is proud of him. Having heard that Yuri has been working a lot despite being a new recruit, Wilker asks how he is doing. Yuri happily answers that this is the job for him and declares to one day catch Twilight. Wilker finds that "real swell" and promises to treat Yuri to a steak dinner sometime.

At headquarters, Wilker receives a report from Division 4 regarding the remnants of the Red Circus group and their leader Billy Squire, who has returned to Ostania.

Wilker sends out a message for an emergency summons, calling all officers to headquarters. Wilker announces to Yuri and the other agents about the return of Winston Wheeler, their intelligence agent from Westalis, who has stolen valuable intel from WISE. He orders them to cooperate with Wheeler's division to secure him once he crosses the border and not to let the pursuing WISE interfere. Later, when the SSS officers arrive at the northwestern region of Shellbury to secure Wheeler, an officer in Yuri's group informs his teammates that Wilker said that their current operation is an unofficial one in order to avoid causing a stir with Westalis.

When Loid disguises himself as Winston to trick the SSS agents, he tells them that he had a yellow gemstone tiepin as his signal, so the agents make a call to Wilker at HQ. After receiving the message, Wilker goes to chat with one of their members, Jeffrey. Wilker reveals to Jeffrey that the agents never specified the gemstone's color, but told other agents different colors. This would reveal who was leaking their information, and Wilker proceeds to expose Jeffrey as a mole for WISE.

Although the SSS's mission ended with a draw, Wilker congratulated Yuri for his fight against Twilight, saying that Yuri was the first ever to land a blow on the spy.

After Yuri, the Lieutenant, and Chloe finish interrogating prisoners, Wilker happily approaches the three and invites them to get steak with him tonight. He says they still need to celebrate Yuri's fight with Twilight, especially with the calmer atmosphere, but the Lieutenant sees his words as an excuse to go drinking. Yuri declines to spend time with his sister, so Wilker and the rest of the SSS officers head out to a bar that night. Wilker eventually leaves to go home, after which the Lieutenant invites Yuri to drink with him and their fellow officers.

Wilker, accompanied by other officers, drives out to a mansion in the forest to meet with the Shopkeeper, the leader of Garden. When two officers protest after they are kept from accompanying Wilker to his meeting, he orders them to stand down as the members of Garden could kill them. After attempting to chat with the Shopkeeper, Wilker presents him with a briefcase filled with files for job requests, mostly from Ostania's prime minister. The first is about the left-right power struggle the prime minister is facing while the second is to have Garden's members represent Ostania in their soccer team for the upcoming East-West games. The Shopkeeper turns them both down until he reads the third file, a poaching case on Miteran elk in southwest Ostania. He accepts the job, explaining to Wilker the historical significance of those lands and how it is a demilitarized zone that could cause friction between East and West. Wilker asks him to consider the other files, but the Shopkeeper rejects him, reminding him that Garden acts in service to the nation, not to a politician. While leaving the mansion with his men, Wilker scoffs at the Shopkeeper, saying that his loyalty is to a dead empire.

Tactician: Wilker appears to be a well-versed tactician, leading his agents with careful plans and directions. His notable plan was devising a strategy to weed out moles in their ranks by deploying a canary trap. During the mission to secure Winston Wheeler, Wilker had his men inform certain branches of their communications division that the signal to identify Winston Wheeler would be a green tie with a gemstone pin, then told each agent a different color. This way, whoever attempted to impersonate Wheeler with the gemstone color would reveal who the mole leaking their information was.

Wilker is the man who scouted and recruited Yuri to the SSS. While the exact reasons are unknown, Wilker says that he did it because he found Yuri "adorable, like a cute little puppy." Yuri appears to be close with Wilker, who has even invited him out for a steak dinner. This has earned Yuri the reputation of being Wilker's "pet" among his peers.

After hearing about Yuri's long work hours, Wilker asks the young man if he is doing alright with his new job. Yuri exclaims that it is the job for him and that he will one day capture Twilight, which Wilker seems to appreciate. After Yuri's fight with Twilight, Wilker praises him, claiming him to being the first person to land a blow on the spy.

entries.name: Yuri Briar
entries.content:
“Unlike you, I love my family. I love my sister. And I will do whatever it takes to protect this country that she lives in.”
— Yuri to Jim Hayward about his ideology

Yuri Briar (ユーリ・ブライア, Yūri Buraia?) is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is Yor Forger's younger brother and a twenty-year-old man who works in the State Security Service. He keeps his job at the SSS a secret from his sister and instead pretends to be a normal civil servant and diplomat at the foreign ministry.

Yuri is a very handsome, elegant, and fairly tall man in his early twenties, with a slender, straight frame. He has a very small cowlick on top of his straight black hair with uneven bangs. Like his sister, Yuri has upturned red eyes. He was once described to be cute by Millie Myers after Yor showed a picture of him to her.

When at work, Yuri wears the SSS's standard uniform. When going outside for undercover missions, he wears a blue bomber jacket with a white shirt underneath, a tan-colored cap, black pants, and brown boots with laces. Outside of work, Yuri wears a light brown trench coat over an all-black suit, a white long-sleeved shirt, and a dark blue tie, along with black gloves and shoes. During these occasions, he typically wears a black wristwatch on his left arm.

Yuri's casual attire when helping Anya study consisted of a black long-sleeved pocket shirt, the pocket being gray with a black and white eye at the top reminiscent of the SSS's symbol, blue jeans, and brown shoes.

As a child and up to college, Yuri had slightly shorter hair.

Yuri has a sister complex, and even at an early age, he would be doing everything he could to get Yor to praise him with affection. Though this could be due to his mother dying at a very early stage in his life, causing him to get very attached to Yor as a mother figure. Just the thought of Yor hating him or in despair brings him great distress. When Yuri was young, he hated himself for not being able to help her as she provided for them, which is why he began studying everything as much as he could so that he could be of help. Due to his smarts, he eventually landed a job at the foreign ministry and, shortly after, the Secret Police, which gave him the power to protect his sister.

When on the job, Yuri is shown to have a very appealing demeanor, even when extracting suspects for information. Yuri truly believes he is protecting his country, though he mostly does it for Yor's benefit, not wanting traitors and scumbags breathing the same air as her. Just as he is passionate for his sister, Yuri is very patriotic, as, when discussing enemies like "Twilight," he swiftly drops his cheery facade and becomes harsher, irritable, and quick-tempered. Yuri also values the importance of family, immediately resorting to violence when he learns of a suspect's excuse for his affair. Idiosyncratically, Yuri loses all his intelligence when it comes to his sister, completely believing Yor's excuses of "forgetting" to tell him about her marriage with Loid for a year and giving in to almost any request she asks for.

Despite his hard and cruel job, Yuri is shown to have a level of empathy. He quickly got angry towards the way Franklin Perkin bullied a group of children, but after understanding the conditions of him and his family, he assured the journalist that his father would receive financial assistance while arresting him. When Franklin posed the question about which of the two of them is the true disgrace, Yuri responded by stating how he would never "cause his sister pain," implying that his sister complex overrides his morals. Yuri also believes that people who lie and deceive others are nothing but scumbags and lowlifes that act like a virus to their country.

Being aware of his capabilities, Yuri tends to act overly cocky and arrogant at times. This often causes others around him to despise him, but he usually does not care how they feel. Yuri also thinks highly of himself for everything he manages to accomplish and becomes extremely depressed whenever he fails, such as when he stewed over his loss against Twilight during an opportune time to capture him. Despite Director Wilker praising him for his efforts, Yuri was very hard on himself for his apparent weakness.

Due to his sister complex, Yuri can act very hypocritical, believing everything he does is for Yor and tending to misinterpret others' words quite easily, causing him to jump to conclusions and behave irrationally at times, which often makes him blind to many things and act recklessly, like when he decided to fight an anti-establishment group by himself and almost got stabbed had his co-worker Chloe not intervened.

Because of his near-inhuman endurance, Yuri has a tendency to disregard his own well-being, even when he is sick or seriously injured. He would even eat Yor's awful cooking and continue doing so until he was forcibly stopped. Yuri also tends to overestimate the limitations of his current capabilities when enduring lethal injuries, believing that he will always get through. For this, he is scolded by Chloe, who reminds Yuri that he can still die and that he needs to take care of himself better. However, Yuri misinterpreted her advice and has begun working to improve his endurance instead. Also, despite his near-inhuman endurance, there are moments when he could not withstand the pain of injuries, especially when lacking motivation, such as when he suddenly became very sick while on the job chasing a suspect, ended up getting shot during the Red Circus hijacking incident, or felt pain from being slapped by Chloe.

Keen Intellect: Despite how he may act, Yuri is extremely intelligent and knowledgeable. Having been a very studious person growing up for the sake of his sister, he has become far more educated than her, even having taught her many things while they were growing up. Later on, Yuri was able to skip grades and attend college at 14 years old, and he was offered a job as a diplomat in his late teens. However, Yuri's intel is that of an amateur compared to Loid, as during his visit to the Forgers, he followed the cover story in the Ostanian Intelligence's deception manual word-for-word without checking if the information was outdated, which allowed Loid to quickly deduce his affiliation with the SSS. It is also seen that within the SSS, Yuri managed to locate, surveil, and capture a journalist in a matter of days.

Interrogation: Yuri is said to be very talented for his age, allowing Wilker to let Yuri tag in for his captain for interrogations and counterintelligence. While interrogating Jim Hayward, an informant working with WISE, Yuri easily caught his bluff and immediately exposed the informant with photos of him handing confidential documents to someone. He is also skilled in interrogation tactics, being able to beat down suspects with no remorse, especially if he snaps at them.

Surveillance Expert: Yuri's talent as a Secret Police officer despite his age is shown again in his surveillance and investigation skills. He is capable of accurately discerning the body types of people and if they are professionals by observing the way they move, even if he has never seen them before. He can even tell if someone is injured just by noticing a sudden twitch in movement. He has proven to be an expert of witnessing and surveying people from afar and gathering intel. This is demonstrated during his assignment in investigating Franklin Perkin, where he carefully logs his every single move and was able to comprehend the motives behind his slanderous journalism.

Immense Durability and Endurance: Yuri has remarkable tolerance to injuries, most likely due to his sister inadvertently harming him in his youth. As an adult, he is durable enough to take two of Yor's drunken hits, albeit sustaining heavy injuries, enough for people to tell him to go to the hospital. He has also been hit by a truck after pulling four all-nighters in a row, sustaining little to no injuries. Having grown up eating Yor's cooking, Yuri is the only person able to eat it without immediately collapsing, though he quickly vomits it the moment he eats it. This has brought about not only physical but psychological changes within him. Tempered by Yor's cooking, Yuri's organs have grown more resilient than the average person's. He also recovers from illnesses quickly. During his fight with Twilight, Yuri persisted in his attempt to capture the spy and continued to get back up after being knocked down several times until he finally collapsed.

Teaching: Yuri has decent teaching skills. When he was a child, he used to help Yor with her studies, and when Anya needed to study for her midterm exams, Yor asked Yuri to help Anya. Unlike his sister, Yuri is an expert with grammatical and logistic problems, making him more reliable when it comes to academic subjects.

Trained Marksman: As a trained SSS agent, Yuri is proficient at marksmanship, able to land a sustaining gunshot wound on Loid's arm while in a compromised position during their confrontation.

Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Yuri is likely well-trained in hand-to-hand combat. He was able to swiftly disable Conrad's gun and pin him down quite easily. However, he falls short against far skilled opponents like Loid, who, for a majority of their fight, had the upper hand. However, as their fight progressed longer than Loid originally expected, Yuri was able to land a few good hits on him.

Alcohol Intolerance: Just like his older sister, Yuri is a lightweight. He is prone to drinking large amounts of alcohol in a short amount of time, pouring wine into his glass eagerly, and drinking wine straight out of the bottle. Intoxication renders him temperamental and unable to think properly, as shown when he forced Yor and Loid to kiss in front of him, a decision he quickly regretted.

Yor: Yuri's biggest weakness is likely his love for his big sister, as whenever she is involved, it derails his otherwise intelligent mind. He becomes prone to extreme overreactions to otherwise minor matters, willing to lie and endure almost anything, primarily Yor's lethal cooking, just to make her happy. He also becomes heavily biased when it comes to matters pertaining to her and bases his abilities on how he can protect her.

Cooking: Similar to his older sister, Yuri is consistently bad at cooking, although the meals prepared by him seem to be simply distasteful rather than poisonous, like the ones prepared by Yor.

(To himself): "Loid Forger. The day you make my sister cry... It'll be a different story."
(To himself): "Now I see... I'm the one who needs to be studying here. I have nowhere near enough power. If I'd had more knowledge myself, I would've captured Twilight that day! I could've put an end to the Western threat right and there! I'm still powerless to protect my sister... to protect my country."
(To Franklin Perkin): "Unlike you, I would never do anything to cause my sister pain. Ever."
(To himself): "I can't let my sweet sister be unhappy. I can't die and leave her all by herself! I'll improve my eating habits. Take better care of myself."

entries.name: SSS Lieutenant
entries.content:
“It's way past time you got over your sister thing. I need your head on the job. Our mission is to catch Western spies, and this "Twilight" character most of all. If you want to protect your sister, that's the way to do it.”
— The Lieutenant to Yuri Briar

The unnamed SSS Lieutenant is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is a scarred man who is a lieutenant working with the State Security Service and Yuri Briar's senior officer.

The Lieutenant is a tall man of intimidating stature. He has short blond hair in an undercut and rectangular-shaped blue eyes with a dark outline. He also has a slim face with defined cheekbones. His distinguishing feature is two stitched scars on the left side of his face, which go down from his forehead to under his eye.

He mainly appears wearing his standard SSS uniform. When going outside, he wears a dark jacket with a black turtleneck underneath, a flat cap, black gloves, and glasses.

The Lieutenant is stern and dedicated to the purpose of his job in the SSS: keeping the "peace" by catching traitors and spies from the West, most notoriously Twilight. While this may be the case, he also cares about his fellow officers, such as his junior, Yuri, whom he tends to get concerned about. When the superior orders him to cover up all information about the developing bus hijacking crisis, the Lieutenant remains silent and stone-faced while his subordinates look nervously.

Interrogation: As a counterintelligence agent, the Lieutenant works in interrogating those who are suspected of espionage. He shows no remorse in his methods and will beat and torture them in order to obtain the information he is seeking.

Yuri is the Lieutenant's junior in the SSS. Working closely with the young man, the Lieutenant often finds himself looking after him as a mentor and making sure to keep him in check. The Lieutenant is aware of Yuri's bad habits and urges him to grow out of them: from his drinking, overworking, and sister complex. Despite these quirks, the Lieutenant acknowledges Yuri's efficiency as an intelligence agent and has been looking out for him. The Lieutenant often insists to Yuri that he should rest whenever he overworks himself, advising him to be careful after hearing about him getting injured, and even tended to Yuri's care after he caught a cold while pursuing a criminal.

One of the Lieutenant's goals is to capture Twilight, the "great threat to the East." Unbeknownst to him, the master spy had once impersonated him to interrogate Yor. During the mission to secure Winston Wheeler, the Lieutenant and Yuri follow Twilight's path down the sewers, with Yuri going ahead by himself while the Lieutenant calls for backup. The Lieutenant and Chloe later find Yuri beaten by Twilight, and he attempts to chase after him alone but fails.

entries.name: Chloe
entries.content:
“Show your sister that you've grown capable of protecting yourself. Otherwise, how are you gonna be able to protect anyone else?”
— Chloe to Yuri Briar

Chloe (クロエ, Kuroe?) is a State Security Service officer and Yuri Briar's junior officer.

Chloe is a young woman with medium-length dark magenta hair in a bob with bangs. Underneath her hair, she wears drop earrings that are in the shape of handcuffs. She has dark pink eyes which are slanted and narrow.

Chloe mainly wears the SSS standard uniform. When undercover in Shellbury, she wore a black cap with an eye at the brim, along with a black jacket and an orange scarf, a white undershirt, gray pants with a checkered pattern, and orange sneakers. In Berlint, while still having the same black cap and white undershirt, Chloe also wears a coat with fur on the collar, dark shorts, and dark boots.

When she was in college, Chloe appeared to have longer hair which she tied in a ponytail.

Chloe appears to be a relaxed and easy-going person, as shown when surrounded by her co-workers. Chloe also shows care for the people she respects and will try to reach out and help them if she sees them in a bad spot. As a Secret Police officer, Chloe takes her work seriously and with pride. During the mission to secure Winston Wheeler at Shellbury, she questioned why they had to be undercover, appearing to be uncomfortable with having to disguise herself in her own country.

Six years before the start of Operation Strix, Chloe attended a college in Ostania. While she was there, she met the 14-year-old Yuri Briar, who suddenly appeared without even completing high school. Chloe would witness Yuri's eccentric personality, from his rudeness towards their classmates, his self-destructive work ethic, and his obsession with his older sister Yor. After college, Chloe heard that Yuri got into government work, and when she joined the SSS, she was surprised to learn that he had done the same and was now her superior officer.

Director Wilker orders an emergency summons to inform his officers of their mission to secure agent Winston Wheeler as he crosses the border to Ostania with valuable intel stolen from Westalian Intelligence. Chloe is present during this meeting, standing behind Yuri.

Chloe, alongside Yuri, the Lieutenant, and another officer, arrive at Shellbury, where the rendezvous with Wheeler will take place. As the officers are dressed incognito, Chloe asks why they are disguising themselves in their own country, saying it is making her jittery. The other officer explains that this is an unofficial operation due to the current government not wanting to disturb their relationship with Westalis, among other concerns.

After the meeting with "Wheeler" reveals that he is actually Twilight in disguise, all of the SSS officers immediately pursue the spy. Yuri goes down the sewers after getting a lead on Twilight but does not send out any signals, prompting the Lieutenant to search for him with Chloe. They find Yuri beaten and unconscious, and Chloe tries to wake him up. Upon awakening, a delirious Yuri mistakes Chloe for Yor and goes in for a hug. Surprised and flustered, Chloe chops at Yuri's head while yelling that she is not his sister, and the Lieutenant tells her not to injure him any further. As Yuri and the Lieutenant catch up on their current situation, Chloe wraps her arms around herself while huffing to herself. The Lieutenant decides to go after Twilight on his own and orders Chloe to bring Yuri back to the surface for medical treatment. As Chloe helps Yuri walk, she tells him that, for a moment, she thought he was really dead. Yuri curses Twilight and swears to continue chasing after him once he is out of the sewers, but Chloe refuses, saying he would only get in the way with his injuries.

The mission to secure Wheeler ultimately ends in a draw after he is captured by WISE while the SSS unveils WISE's mole in their ranks. However, thanks to Yuri's fight with Twilight, all of the SSS are actively searching for suspicious individuals in Ostania with the same arm wound as the spy. Chloe arrests Bobby Bockle of the Chicken Circle and takes him to headquarters for interrogation after believing he matches Twilight's arm injury. However, she is surprised when Yuri and the Lieutenant dismiss her suspect after she shows him to them. Before leaving, the Lieutenant orders Yuri to help Chloe with the interrogation.

While interrogating Bobby, Chloe notices Yuri taking out his frustrations on the suspect. After Bobby reveals the location of the Chicken Circle, Yuri and Chloe head out to investigate the base together, with the latter driving them there. During the drive, Chloe inquires Yuri about his recent mood. While they talk about Yuri's ongoing behavior since their college days, he suddenly hides himself in the car, having smelled Yor and heard her footsteps nearby. As they drive past a crosswalk, Chloe sees Yor and is creeped out by Yuri's ability to sense her. The two begin to argue about making up an excuse if Yor saw them, with Chloe suggesting that Yuri could have said that they were lovers. Yuri refuses the idea, saying that he could never do that to the woman who set aside her own happiness for him. Not having little brothers of her own, Chloe is confused and says that she would want Yuri to find happiness if she were Yor.

The pair arrive at the Chicken Circle's base. Before Chloe can attempt a reconnaissance trip, Yuri charges in alone, despite her protests. After listening to Yuri's fight with the men inside, Chloe enters the building just in time to save Yuri from being stabbed by disarming and defeating the attacker. Chloe slaps some sense into Yuri and admonishes him for his recklessness, reminding him that people like him can die. She asks Yuri how Yor would feel if he died and points out how everything he says he does is all for her, calling him a self-serving hypocrite. Chloe then expresses her admiration for Yuri's fortitude but says that it leaves him blind to too many things.

Yuri apologizes, and Chloe does the same, realizing she went a little overboard in getting her point across to him. Chloe tells Yuri that the way Yor supported him might seem normal due to their time together but says there are other ways people can support each other. She instructs him to take better care of himself and be able to prove it to Yor. To her astonishment, Yuri concludes that he must improve his defensive skills in evading and blocking.

As springtime approaches, Chloe, Yuri, and the Lieutenant are busy with interrogating a recent wave of extremist prisoners. After interrogations, Wilker invites the trio out to have steak together at night to celebrate Yuri's fight with Twilight. Much to Chloe's shock, Yuri declines the steak invitation as he has a date in the evening, though the Lieutenant correctly guesses that it will be with Yor. Later that night, the SSS officers go to a bar to go drinking. After Wilker leaves, the Lieutenant calls Yuri at his apartment to invite him out for bar hopping with their fellow officers. He also jokes that Chloe misses him, which she denies in embarrassment.

Trained Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Chloe is well-trained in hand-to-hand combat. She was able to prevent Yuri from a surprise attack by quickly disarming and taking down the would-be attacker.

Surveillance: Despite her occupation, Chloe seems to have rather poor surveillance skills, as she brought in Bobby Bockle, a short and plump man, as a possible Twilight suspect, based solely on the information that he had a gunshot wound on his arm.

Yuri is Chloe's superior officer in the SSS, and she refers to him as "Lieutenant" while they work together. She first met Yuri when he was 14 and attending the same college as her. As his college senior, Chloe is aware of Yuri's history of being despised by most people because of his impertinence, which she jokes about to him later on. She also admires his fortitude and toughness in both his heart and body, though she points out that it leaves him blind to too many things, including his own safety. Despite their difference in ranks, Chloe can be very casual with Yuri, as she is not afraid to speak her mind around him, nor is she against hitting him when he goes out of line.

entries.name: Camilla
entries.content:
“You've seemed kind of different lately, Yor. You always used to have this dumb, blank face. Like you were a robot or something.”
— Camilla to Yor Forger

Camilla (カミラ, Kamira?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is one of Yor Forger's three co-workers at Berlint City Hall.

Camilla is a young woman with blonde hair, yellow eyes, light skin, and short eyebrows. Her hair appears smooth and carefully curled at the ends, reaching her shoulders. Occasionally, Camilla ties her hair in a low ponytail. Her eye color varies from yellow to green in illustrations and official art from the manga and anime, appearing yellow in the anime and colored manga, blue in chapter illustrations, and green in the cover for Volume 13. She also normally wears bright red lipstick except when she's home.

Camilla is seen wearing the Berlint City Hall uniform with a green vest over a white long-sleeved shirt, a green skirt, and black heels.

When she was at her party, Camilla wore a purple sleeveless mid-length dress with several accessories, such as a golden butterfly-shaped brooch on her chest, two golden bracelets of different sizes on her left arm, and a beaded bracelet on her right arm. She was also wearing blue heels.

When Yor visited her house to learn how to cook, Camilla wore a purple long-sleeved shirt, a white flowy skirt that reaches below her knees, and black heels.

Camilla is initially shown to be snobbish and mean-spirited, especially toward Yor as she invited her to the party merely to make fun of her being single. She also appears to be petty and prone to jealously as after learning that Yor is married to Loid Forger, she attempts to humiliate her further by spilling hot gratin on Yor, thinking about falsely reporting her as a possible spy, and even making unsavory remarks about her old job. Despite her thorny exterior, she has a soft side and accedes to patiently teach Yor cooking when she pleads, despite her initial frustration.

Cooking: Camilla appears to be a good cook, being able to recreate Yor and Yuri's childhood stew from just their memories. She is also knowledgeable about cooking variations from other parts of Ostania, as she adjusts the recipe after asking about Yor's hometown. It is quite likely that she cooked the dishes at her house party.

Dominic is Camilla's boyfriend and also works at Berlint City Hall. Despite Dominic not approving of her harsh remarks towards Yor, he still amours Camilla, being able to see her genuine nice side. The feeling appears to be mutual with Camilla as she seems to be defensive and possessive of him, pulling him back when he merely talked to Yor at her party. When Dominic called Camilla cute for patiently helping Yor in cooking, she easily gets embarrassed.

Yor is Camilla's fellow co-worker among the female city hall clerks. Before getting to know Yor, Camilla was not on good terms with her, as she gossiped and made fun of her for not being normal. Camilla invites Yor to her party and tells her to bring a partner, despite believing that she could never bring a man over anyway. At the party, Camilla and Millie mock Yor for showing up alone, and she even declares to make sure Yor's brother knows that. Later, she gets jealous when Yor is revealed to be married to Loid, a refined and handsome man, and tries to spill hot gratin on her to "take her down a notch." After that fails, Camilla even goes as far as bringing up Yor's previous job to Loid and implies that she was doing obscene work. However, after Loid brings up Yor's difficult past growing up, Camilla backs off.

After Yor's marriage to Loid is revealed, Camilla and the other girls begin having a lot more to talk about with her, with Yor often coming to them for advice regarding her marriage. Most times, Millie and Camilla would not offer much help and try to suggest that Yor break up with Loid.

Despite Camilla continuing to behave condescendingly and harshly toward Yor, she says Camilla always seemed like a wonderful person. Their relationship appears to improve after Camilla reluctantly teaches Yor how to cook to improve her home cooking and finds out how bad she is in the kitchen. Despite getting fed up with Yor's clumsiness, she relents after seeing how serious Yor is about her marriage with Loid and remembering Yor's past, so she earnestly teaches her co-worker how to cook. She later notes that Yor appears to have changed after marrying Loid.

One afternoon, when Millie and Camilla get stuck at city hall to finish their overtime work, Yor repays the favor for Camilla's cooking lessons and offers to help to finish their work alongside Sharon, much to Camilla's gratitude. Later that night, the ladies have their after-work dinner with Yor for the first time. As they chat about their partners and tease Yor about her marriage, Camilla and the others get to see a new side of Yor, which they all find cute and amusing.

Sharon is one of Camilla's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. She appears to befriend her as they frequently talk and hang out together, even outside of work.

Millie is another one of Camilla's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. They appear to get along with each other as they often talk and gossip together, even after work hours.

Camilla first meets Yuri when Dominic invites him over to taste test at Yor's cooking lesson, though she has already seen pictures of him through Yor. She is surprised at how different Yuri is from the photos when he thanks her for helping Yor. The two do not interact much, with Yuri only getting upset at her when she yells at Yor but decides she is okay after she tells Yor to divorce Loid.

entries.name: Millie Myers
entries.content:
“Well, at least the soldiers survived. They made it home, didn't they? Hip hip hooray for them, right? But not my dad. He didn't get to come home at all!”
— Millie to Lady Patriots Society

Millie Myers (ミリー・マイヤーズ, Mirī Maiyāzu?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is one of Yor Forger's three co-workers at Berlint City Hall.

Millie is a young woman with light skin and eyes that are slanted downwards with long eyelashes. Her chin-length strawberry blonde hair is styled into a bob curling inwards with her fringe swept to the right of her face. Millie's hair color varies from blonde to orange in illustrations and official art from the manga and anime, appearing orange or strawberry blonde in the anime and colored manga, while closer to a darker blonde in the cover for Volume 13. She also has green eyes in the colored manga and the cover for Volume 13, but they are light blue in chapter illustrations and the anime.

Millie is seen wearing the Berlint City Hall uniform with a green vest over a white long-sleeved shirt and a green skirt. Her skirt is noticeably shorter than her co-workers, with thigh-high black socks and black heels. She also wears a small red ribbon to the right side of her head and a pair of round earrings.

At Camilla's party, Millie wears a strapless red dress with frills along the top and a belt fitted below the bust. She sports a pearl necklace with her round earrings and the ribbon on the right side of her head is thinner. Her high heels are red and have flower decals along the back.

Millie is shown to be lively and mischievous, suggesting to Yor that they put snot in their section chief's coffee as a joke and most often seen smiling or giggling. Even though she later breaks up with her boyfriend, she does not seem bothered and remains cheerful, even asking Yor to introduce her to Yuri, when she hears that he is attractive.

Underneath Millie's lively behavior is a very emotional young woman. Due to losing her father to the second East-West war at a very young age, Millie developed a strong sense of loneliness from his absence. She blames this loneliness for things not going well for her and her anger. Additionally, Millie also developed a dislike of being alone, something that Camilla points out to her. In the past, Millie had a difficult time working at the charity bazaar for disabled veterans due to how it reminded her of her father, to the point that she did not attend the event the year prior, crying and refusing to come.

After meeting Melinda Desmond, Millie expresses her anger toward her and the Desmond family under the notion that Donovan Desmond is a monster who started the war that took her father from her. Millie's claim is corrected by Matthew McMahon and she receives an apology from Melinda, who empathizes with her resentment. After realizing her mistake, Millie apologizes to Melinda and thanks her co-workers, especially Yor, for being there for her, and decides to keep helping at the charity event.

Millie's fellow co-worker among the female city hall clerks. Before getting to know Yor, Millie was not on good terms with her, and while she appeared to act friendly, she threw in insults at Yor and even partook in nasty gossiping about her with Camilla and Sharon. After Yor's marriage to Loid is revealed at Camilla's party, Millie and the other girls begin having a lot more to talk about with her, with Yor often coming to them for advice regarding her marriage. Most times, Millie and Camilla would not offer much help and try to suggest that Yor break up with Loid.

One afternoon, when Millie and Camilla get stuck at city hall to finish their overtime work, Yor and Sharon decide to help them, much to their gratitude. Later that night, the ladies have their after-work dinner with Yor for the first time. As they chat about their partners and tease Yor about her marriage, Millie and the others get to see a new side of Yor, which they all find cute and amusing.

Later, while working together at the charity bazaar, Millie is touched when Yor defends her from members of the Lady Patriots Society verbally attacking her for feeling down about her father's death during the event. When she learns that Yor is friends with Melinda Desmond, she feels betrayed that someone could be friends with the wife of a "monster" who started the war that took her father and has an outburst. After her history is corrected by Matthew McMahon and talking with Melinda, Millie thanks Yor, grateful for her support. Now seeing her in a newer light, Millie changes her view of Yor from a "weird, clueless robot" to a "kindly gorilla," something that a clueless Yor does not take offense to.

Camilla is one of Millie's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. They are often seen talking and gossiping together, even after work. And the two would also frequently tease Yor together.

Sharon is another one of Millie's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. Despite the different amount of energy they each give off, they appear to get along enough to hang out together, though Sharon would occasionally demand her to dial it down a bit.

entries.name: Sharon
entries.content:
Sharon (シャロン?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is one of Yor Forger's three co-workers at Berlint City Hall. She has a six-year-old son who is studying at the Eden Academy.

“She’s always been weird. Let’s just leave it at that.”
— Sharon (to Camilla and Millie, about Yor)

Sharon is a young woman with light skin and long black hair combed back. Her eyes are usually obscured by her glasses but are shown to be narrowed with a disinterested expression when visible. Sharon has purple eyes in the anime, the colored manga, and the cover for Volume 13, but they are black in chapter illustrations.

Sharon wears a large plain barrette at the back of her head, pulling back her hair, and half-rim glasses. She is seen wearing the Berlint City Hall uniform with a vest over a long-sleeved shirt and knee-length skirt, along with a pair of dangling earrings.

At Camilla's party, Sharon wears a long-sleeved blouse with shin-length black pants. She sports a hairpiece on the right side of her head and black heels.

Sharon is shown to be largely indifferent or disinterested, not actively making fun of Yor like her co-workers nor preventing them, though she tells Millie to cool it when she suggests Yor may be able to find a man if she stopped being airheaded.

Yor's fellow co-worker among the female city hall clerks. Like her co-workers, they were initially not on good terms with Yor, with Sharon acting very indifferent when it came to her. When Camilla invites Yor to her party and tells her to bring a partner, Sharon jabs that it might be too much for her. On the night of the party, after Yor fails to arrive with a partner, Sharon does not partake in Camilla and Millie's suggestions to report her to the SSS and tells them to leave her alone, simply chalking Yor up to being weird. After Yor's "marriage" with Loid is revealed, Sharon begins finding a lot more to talk to her about, especially when Yor goes to her to ask for advice about her marriage.

They also find more in common as they both have children attending Eden Academy in the same year. As such, when Yor gets worried about Anya coming home late from a field trip (unaware that the bus got hijacked), she calls Sharon to confirm Anya's whereabouts. As Yor continues to talk with her co-workers more, Sharon eventually invites her to her, Camilla, and Millie's usual after-work dinner. During this dinner, the ladies discover a new side of Yor that they find pure and adorable as they tease her about her marriage with Loid.

Camilla is one of Sharon's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. They are frequently seen together. When Sharon and Camilla are not working, they are usually talking or hanging out, with Yor's marriage being a popular topic.

Millie is another of Sharon's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. Despite their varying levels of energy, they get along well enough to hang out together.

entries.name: Matthew McMahon
entries.content:
“So long as people are the way they are, the fighting won't ever stop. We're soldiers. Whether people call it wartime or peacetime, we keep fighting for our country.”
— Matthew to Zeb

Matthew McMahon (マシュー・マクマホン, Mashū Makumahon?) is a member of Garden and is also the Director of Policy at Berlint City Hall. He assists Yor Forger during her mission aboard the Princess Lorelei.

Matthew is an elderly man of average build and height. He has narrow black eyes hidden under reflective glasses and gray hair parted down the middle. His outfit consists of a white shirt under a dark gray business suit and a dark teal tie. Matthew also wears a ring on his left ring finger.

Matthew is a blunt and straightforward individual. He maintains an air of professionalism, even when presented with the risk of death. Similar to Yor, he remains relatively unfazed when fighting enemies. He has demonstrated mild exasperation with the latter for killing so messily, commenting on the effort it would take to clean up the scene.

Matthew is dedicated to his job as an assassin, believing that they are soldiers and nothing more, even reminding Yor when he notices her emotions affecting her focus. Despite that, Matthew is more empathetic than he appears to be as he allows Yor to be family after noticing these emotions, likely due to him having a family of his own. Matthew also dislikes war and those who start it for financial gain, believing that Ostania would be better off without them.

Despite his appearance as a frail old man, Matthew is still an active member of Garden, acting as a competent killer despite his advanced age.

Enhanced Strength and Stamina: Matthew demonstrated his strength by effortlessly picking up and throwing the corpses of fully grown adults off the cruise ship using just one hand. He can also break an assassin's arms and legs with ease and was able to pierce Knockman's hands with throwing darts.

Enhanced Durability and Endurance: Despite his seemingly frail structure, Matthew has showcased great durability and endurance. He survived an intense blow from the Swordsman's hilt that sent him crashing into a wall. Though it left him temporarily unconscious and mildly wounded, he was able to recover and quickly land a shot on the Assassin Leader before he could shoot Yor.

Enhanced Speed and Agility: Matthew displays great speed and reflexes. He was able to swiftly dodge a knife swung by an assassin and disabled him just as quickly, leaving a wind trail behind him as he did so. In addition to blocking an attack using a broom, he was able to dodge a close-up sword strike just as fast as Yor. Additionally, he was able to dodge a stab from behind while cleaning up blood.

He was fast enough to be able to disappear from his vantage point and reappear behind Yor, with the latter noticing only after he spoke, though this may have been for comedic effect and not a true reflection of his speed.

Weapons: It seems that Matthew prefers to use mostly firearms, including a sniper rifle which he wields with great proficiency. He was able to kill three opponents in quick succession without a reaction from any of them. In close-quarters combat, he relies on a silenced gun. However, it is assumed that he periodically uses cold weapons, such as throwing darts, as well as knives, which were seen in his briefcase. On one occasion, he has also used a broom to defend himself.

Cleaning: Like Yor, Matthew has expert cleaning skills. During their battle with the assassins, Matthew brought along a broom and bucket to clean up blood from Yor's fight and quickly managed to keep the deck of the ship clean after their kills. By the end of their fight with the assassins, Matthew was able to keep the deck spotless.

During his work at city hall and Garden, Matthew rarely speaks about his wife, a civilian. While the two do not discuss Matthew's assassin work, they appear as an average family, with Matthew, in his own words: "living the typical life of a husband dominated by his controlling wife." According to Matthew, they also shared welcome home kisses in their younger days.

Keekee is Matthew's pet falcon. During the mission to protect Miteran elk from poachers, Matthew uses her to help scout the forest. He is quite fond of the bird, being proud of her special training and calling her cute.

Matthew is Yor's supervisor in both Garden and at city hall. He and Yor have a professional relationship since they both work under the Shopkeeper and appear to regularly meet with him together. Despite that, they both care about each other in times of danger, as on several occasions, they looked out for each other while fighting the assassins on Princess Lorelei.

Throughout their mission to protect Olka Gretcher on the ship, Matthew acts as Yor's senior, giving her instructions and keeping her in check. He notices Yor losing focus on the job and emphasizes several times to her that they are nothing more than foot soldiers. However, at the end of their mission, as Matthew says they must remain vigilant, he sees Yor's sentimental expression and relays to her that her family requested to meet with her. Saying that he will stay on the lookout for more assassins, Matthew allows Yor to be with her family, telling her to think of it as a reward for completing her job.

(To Yor Forger): "Stay focused on the job...or everyone will die."
(To Yor Forger): "These do appear to be a fairly talented bunch. Plenty of new faces with unfamiliar fighting styles among them. That said... they're hardly in the Garden's league."
(To the Assassin Leader): "People who see war as just another way to make a buck... Ostania would be better off without them... I'd expect more foresight from a businessman. Take a moment to reflect on that as you're being eaten by the sharks."
(To Millie Myers): "It is a boorish deed to apply unwarranted blame due to one's own ignorance. Learn your history."

entries.name: Dominic
entries.content:
“Now, now, Camilla, you're a beautiful woman too. Have some confidence!”
— Dominic to Camilla

Dominic (ドミニク, Dominiku?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is part of the staff at Berlint City Hall. He is a friend of Yuri Briar and is dating Camilla, Yor Forger's co-worker.

Dominic is a man of average height with fair skin and appears to be quite built. He has dirty blond hair styled into a pompadour with a small strand of hair hanging loose on his forehead and some stubble on his chin.

At the party, he wears a green sweater over a white collared shirt with a brown coat, along with black trousers and brown shoes.

At Berlint City Hall, he is seen wearing a white button-up shirt with a striped tie and dark trousers.

Dominic is a polite and friendly man, in contrast to his girlfriend's usually brash and thorny personality. He always tries to calm her down and stop her from picking on Yor, and is the first to ask Loid about his condition when he arrives to the party injured.

After Yuri calls Yor to check up on her and learns that she is bringing a date to Camilla's party, he asks Dominic to see what sort of boyfriend Yor has.

At the party, Yor shows up alone, and Dominic expresses his regrets for not being able to meet her boyfriend. He also mentions how Yuri is always worried about her, and Yor requests that he tell Yuri that she brought someone nice. However, a jealous Camilla joins their conversation and rudely rejects her plea, mocking her for wanting to look good in front of her brother and declaring that Dominic will be sure to tell Yuri that she came alone. Dominic quickly apologizes to Yor for Camilla's attitude before pulling her away.

When Loid suddenly enters the party, injured and bleeding, Dominic expresses concern for his state. He later has to pull Camilla away in an attempt to stop her when she exposes suggestive rumors about Yor's previous career to Loid.[2]

At their apartment building, Dominic crosses paths with Yuri and comments that they have not seen each other for a while due to Yuri's job keeping him busy. Remembering his previous request, Yuri asks him about Yor and her date at the party. Dominic is a bit surprised that he has not had the chance to meet Yor's husband, but hearing Yor has gotten married shocks Yuri.[3]

Dominic tells Camilla about his meeting with Yuri and how he was unaware of Yor's marriage. The next day, Camilla relays this to Yor, who panics after remembering that she forgot to tell him.[4]

When Yor asks her co-workers for help on how to cook, Dominic overhears the conversation and suggests Yor learn how to cook at Camilla's house. When Camilla attempts to refuse, he insists.

On the second day of their cooking classes, Dominic invites Yuri over to act as Yor's taste tester after Camilla's complaints about having to taste Yor's poisonous cooking. After watching Yuri happily eat one of Yor's dishes and claim it is delicious while throwing it up, the couple takes a cautious bite but collapses immediately after. Dominic later has to stop Yuri from almost dying as he eagerly devours another one of Yor's dishes. Hearing Yor's memories of her cooking for her brother, Dominic tearfully thanks the heavens that Yuri managed to survive to adulthood.[1] After the Briar siblings leave, Camilla says she is exhausted. Dominic stares at her, and after she asks what he is doing, he tells her that he was just admiring how cute she was. Camilla becomes flustered by his remark and tells him to shut up.[5]

When the city hall girls hang out for dinner, Camilla talks about Dominic, having told him to: "be more cutthroat if you want to get ahead." After Yor tells the others that she has no gripes with Loid, Camilla and the girls complain about their partners, with Camilla saying that whenever she and Dominic go on a date and he shows up 20 minutes late and goofily laughs it off, it makes her want to kill him.[6]

The city hall workers are assigned to help at the charity bazaar for disabled veterans. Camilla, in particular, is excited to be there as the actor, Kevin, will be attending, and Camilla hopes to befriend him. Dominic discourages her from doing that, thinking that he cannot compete with a hunk like Kevin, and Camilla teases him for being jealous. As Millie tells them to stop flirting, Matthew McMahon tells them to stay on the job as they are being watched by the Wounded Veteran Alliance and the Lady Patriots Society. Yor says that she knows the chairwoman of the group, Melinda Desmond, but Camilla and the others do not believe her. Camilla says that former First Ladies do not associate with municipal employees, which gets Dominic to bring up her wanting to befriend Kevin. Yor wonders if Melinda will make an appearance at the event, but Dominic tells her that it is unheard of due to Melinda having many enemies.

When Millie becomes emotionally overwhelmed and decides to head back to the office, Dominic is shocked and refuses as they are already shorthanded. He and Yor are confused as they watch Camilla and Sharon console Millie, and before Sharon can explain Millie's situation, she gets interrupted by women from the Lady Patriots Society, who tell the city hall workers to get back to work. As the women from the group insult the younger adults for being ignorant of the soldiers' suffering, Millie talks back to them and says that even though those soldiers survived and returned home, her dad was not one of them, and Dominic is surprised by this revelation.

The women from the Lady Patriots Society verbally attack Millie, but Yor and her other co-workers defend her. During the exchange, Dominic simply watches and tries to dissuade his co-workers from escalating the situation. Melinda Desmond herself arrives, and after talking with Millie, is able to de-escalate things. After Melinda leaves, Dominic comments that she really seems nothing like her husband. Dominic then walks with the girls, and as he listens to their conversation, he wonders aloud when they started getting so friendly.

Dominic is Camilla's boyfriend. He is the opposite pole of Camilla, as he is friendly and polite while she is thorny. Despite this, he seems to truly like her. Dominic says that despite her manners, Camilla is a noble person. He even felt proud seeing his girlfriend being patient at teaching Yor how to cook.

Dominic is Yuri's apartment neighbor and friend. Since he works at city hall with Yor, Yuri is able to ask him for updates on her life. He is also genuinely relieved that Yuri lived to adulthood when he hears how he ate Yor's terrible cooking as a child.[8] Despite their friendship, Dominic is unaware of Yuri's true job as a member of the State Security Service, only knowing him as a diplomat for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.[9]

Although they are co-workers at city hall, Dominic and Yor do not appear to see each other often nor communicate closely. However, he treats her well and is ready to offer help since she is Yuri's sister. He was also the one who advised her to ask Camilla for help in cooking and pushed for it to happen, even agreeing to be a test taster. With their help, Yor learned to cook a dish from her childhood.

entries.name: Franky Franklin
entries.content:
“I already told you once—you gotta keep your emotions out of this. If you value your life, never trust anyone. That's just how people like you and me gotta live.”
— Franky to Loid Forger

Franky Franklin (フランキー・フランクリン, Furankī Furankurin?) is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. While he appears to be a tobacco store clerk, he is secretly an informant who is an associate of Loid Forger and provides him with intel, having got him information regarding Eden Academy's exam and Anya's past records.

Franky is a man with a square face, round eyes, and an upturned nose. He has big, curly dark brown hair and a short goatee.

Franky usually wears a white dress shirt with the sleeves rolled up, an orange tie, purple dress pants with black suspenders, orange and white striped socks, and brown shoes. He also sports glasses with a thick red frame and an earring on his left earlobe.

Franky is an affable person willing to help Loid out whenever he is in a pinch, even though the danger is high. He frequently warns Loid not to get too close to other people in their line of work. Despite this advice, Franky frequently falls in love with other women, but his love life typically fails due to a lack of mutual interest or because they are already with someone else. In contrast, Franky is more successful with friends, as he knows many people and is popular enough to be greeted by many visitors at a club.

Franky is a rather money-driven person, as he is willing to perform favors for Loid if the spy promises to give him material goods, even if he was previously reluctant to do so or the situation was extremely dangerous.

Having participated in the second East-West war, Franky came to understand that the war was a result of a diplomatic failure and deemed it stupid and pointless for regular people to kill each other on their respective nation's orders, which led him to defect from the Ostanian army. While he lives in Ostania, Franky dislikes the government's oppressive nature and is willing to collaborate with Westalian agents like Loid and Fiona by secretly passing them intel, which Franky considers his way of fighting back.

As an informant, Franky's primary skills are information gathering and making contacts.

Intelligence Gathering: Franky is an extraordinarily impressive informant, being able to access a vast amount of highly secure information without getting caught or noticed by the SSS, from accessing and copying a large pile of personal documents regarding info on unmarried women in the city to getting the answers to an exam from Eden Academy. He also has access to a large network of contacts and fellow informants, allowing him to quickly gather information and borrow a large variety of skills as needed, as well as go around the city unnoticed.

Inventing: Being one of his passions, Franky can build a variety of gadgets, though they are often niche or extremely limited in use. While he has made many inventions to show off to Loid, very few are practical enough to be used by him.

Wide Circle of Acquaintances: Franky has a very large circle of acquaintances. He knows many people doing different jobs in different places and uses these connections to provide information to WISE agents such as Loid and Fiona and sometimes for his own interests. It seems that Franky has good and even friendly relations with some of his acquaintances.

Known Inventions
C20 Feline-Form Listening Device: A listening device designed in the shape of a regular-sized house cat, intended for searching for lost cats. It is loaded with many sensors and will react if a target approaches.
Cat Nearness Inducement Prototype (CAT-N.I.P.) Decoy System: A machine that releases the scent of catnip, intended to lure lost cats in. The fact that it also lures in other cats is admittedly a design defect.
Hyper Long Hand: A device that quickly shoots out a grapple to capture a target. However, it can only shoot out in a straight line, so it is not ideal against targets that can quickly sidestep.
Camera-Shaped Net Launcher: A net launcher built to appear as a normal camera. It is ideally used for surprise captures, as it launches a net out of the camera's viewfinder. However, its range is only a mere two meters, so it is best used at very close range.
Exoskeleton Power Suit: Franky's ultimate weapon, which he developed for a decade. It granted incredible superhuman strength, though only after a 15-minute warm-up cycle. Unfortunately for Franky, Yor destroyed the suit before he got the chance to use it during their attempts to catch the cat Kopi.
Abso-waker Type-J: Franky's alarm clock in his Little Yapong hideout. The invention is Yapong-themed, consisting of two mini sumo wrestlers on two sides that smack Franky awake. If those fail to wake him up, a mechanical samurai standing in front of the bed will slice down on his head with a real-life sword as punishment.
Senju: A multi-armed invention created to be a "life-enhancement device" that would be worn by Franky and boost his productivity several times over by completing multiple tasks through its mechanical arms. It is currently a work in progress, as it blew up before Franky could begin using it.
Other inventions include:
A machine to talk to women on dates based on the flowchart Loid made for him.
